6943: function openPostgameSummary(gameId) {

6975:       scheduledGame?.postgameSummary ||
6976:       null;

6978:     /*
6979:      * Older completed career games may have a valid frozen
6980:      * box score but no usable Development Engine result because
6981:      * they were completed before the participation/progression
6982:      * fixes.
6983:      *
6984:      * Repair only when the saved progression package is missing.
6985:      * The World Engine's permanent game-log guard prevents the
6986:      * same game from awarding XP twice.
6987:      */
6988:     const hasSavedCareerDevelopment =
6989:       Boolean(
6990:         summary
6991:           ?.development
6992:           ?.progressionResult
6993:           ?.created === true

6999:       typeof WorldEngine
7000:         .repairCompletedGameDevelopment ===
7001:           'function'
7002:     ) {
7003:       /*
7004:        * Development repair is optional display maintenance. It must never
7005:        * prevent a completed hockey game from opening its Postgame Summary.
7006:        */
7007:       try {
7008:         const repairResult =
7009:           WorldEngine
7010:             .repairCompletedGameDevelopment(
7011:               canonicalPostgameGameId
7012:             );
7013: 
7014:         if (
7015:           repairResult?.success === true
7016:         ) {

7018:             scheduledGame.postgameSummary ||
7019:             summary;
7020:         } else {
7021:           console.warn(
7022:             '[Postgame Summary] Development repair failed.',
7023:             repairResult
7024:           );
7025:         }
7026:       } catch (error) {
7027:         console.warn(
7028:           '[Postgame Summary] Development repair threw; continuing to summary.',
7029:           error
7030:         );
7031:       }
7032:     }
7033: 
7034:     if (
7035:       !scheduledGame ||
7036:       !summary
7037:     ) {
